channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — Cyprus Edition
channel.description: Latest Cyprus business, fintech, compliance and regtech intelligence from BusinessHub.cy.

item.title: Anti-corruption body GRECO issues new guide highlighting the importance of binding codes of conduct
item.description: GRECO's new guide mandates that anti-corruption codes of conduct for public and private sectors must be binding and enforceable with sanctions to ensure effective integrity standards.

item.title: Simplification of legislation
item.description: The EU continues its legislative simplification efforts through the REFIT programme, aiming to reduce administrative burdens and improve regulatory efficiency for businesses across member states.

item.title: EIOPA elects Stavros Konstantas of the Bank of Greece to its Management Board
item.description: Stavros Konstantas of the Bank of Greece has been elected to the EIOPA Management Board, bringing significant regional expertise to EU insurance and pension oversight.

item.title: EIB unlocks half of planned €800 million in financing for Romania’s Cernavodă nuclear plant refurbishment
item.description: The EIB has released €400 million of a planned €800 million loan to refurbish Romania's Cernavodă nuclear plant, securing long-term low-carbon energy for the region.

item.title: Digital firms drive surge in business R&D as government R&D budgets across the OECD fall for a second consecutive year
item.description: Global public R&D budgets are declining for a second year while private sector digital and AI R&D spending surges by double digits.

item.title: Vulnerability profiles of least developed countries
item.description: UNCTAD has released updated vulnerability profiles for Least Developed Countries (LDCs) to assess their readiness for graduation from the LDC category.

item.title: EIC Fund companies highlight its role in supporting fundraising and growth
item.description: A new EIC Fund survey confirms its vital role in startup fundraising and credibility, while highlighting a growing focus on dual-use and defense technologies.

item.title: Infocredit Group and Mastercard to Sponsor the 27th NextGen Payments & RegTech Forum in Cyprus
item.description: Meet the team on 19 November 2026 at the Four Seasons Hotel in Limassol to discuss financial crime compliance, payment fraud prevention and third-party cyber risk.

item.title: Road Freight Transport: 2nd Quarter 2026
item.description: Road freight in Cyprus saw a 2.3% tonnage increase in H1 2026, despite a significant drop in tonne-kilometres, indicating shorter haulage distances.

item.title: Welcome address by the Chief Scientist for Research, Innovation and Technology of the Republic of Cyprus, Mr Demetris Skourides, at the Cyprus Fintech Summit 2026
item.description: Cyprus Chief Scientist outlines a vision for the island to become a global hub for intelligent finance and agentic AI under the Vision 2035 framework.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Group MSC
item.description: President Christodoulides met with MSC Group CFO Alexa Aponte Vago to discuss the shipping giant's ongoing operations and strategic presence in Cyprus.

item.title: Opening Keynote Address of the Chief Scientist for Research, Innovation and Technology of the Republic of Cyprus, Dr Demetris Skourides, at the 10th PMI Cyprus Chapter Project Management Conference
item.description: Chief Scientist Demetris Skourides calls for a paradigm shift in Cyprus's project management, emphasizing the integration of AI to move from execution to 'intelligent execution.'

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Inauguration of the new premises of “Ethnikos Assias” Association
item.description: President Christodoulides inaugurated the new premises of the Ethnikos Assias Association in Strovolos, signaling continued state support for refugee-linked community organizations.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – 47th CIM-Cyprus Business School Graduation Ceremony
item.description: President Christodoulides addressed the 47th graduation ceremony of CIM-Cyprus Business School, highlighting the role of specialized education in driving the national economy.

item.title: Commission seeks feedback on draft template for the fundamental rights impact assessment under the AI Act
item.description: The EU Commission has launched a consultation and testing phase for the mandatory Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA) template required under the AI Act for high-risk systems.

item.title: €9.5 million EU support for fast emergency repair of Baltic Sea submarine cables
item.description: The EU is funding the development of rapid submarine cable repair capacities, with a €40 million call now open for the Mediterranean region, including Cyprus.

item.title: Commission hosts Apply AI Summit to boost Europe’s AI innovation and uptake
item.description: The European Commission's Apply AI Summit convenes industry leaders to accelerate AI adoption across 10 strategic sectors and recognize innovative European AI startups.

item.title: UAE Signs Agreement to Host 2029 World Bank Group and IMF Annual Meetings in Abu Dhabi
item.description: The UAE officially signed an agreement to host the 2029 World Bank Group and IMF Annual Meetings in Abu Dhabi, solidifying its status as a global financial hub.

item.title: Mastercard and World Bank Group launch $500 million global risk facility to expand financial access
item.description: Mastercard and the World Bank's IFC launch a $500M risk facility to expand digital payment access in emerging markets, including those in Europe.

item.title: EBA supports further progress on the Banking Union, including on deposit insurance
item.description: The European Banking Authority reaffirms its support for a common European deposit insurance scheme to bolster the Banking Union by 2027.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of investment compartment of ROVENTER REAL ESTATE of RAIF CP. VT. ROVENTER INVESTMENTS RAIF V.C.I.C. LTD
item.description: CySEC announces the initiation of the dissolution and liquidation process for the ROVENTER REAL ESTATE investment compartment of CP. VT. ROVENTER INVESTMENTS RAIF V.C.I.C. LTD.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of investment compartment of AN.NIK.A. SUBFUND 1 of RAIF AN.NIK.A RAIF V.C.I.C. LTD
item.description: CySEC announces the initiation of dissolution and liquidation procedures for AN.NIK.A. SUBFUND 1, managed by Argus Management Ltd.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of the investment compartment HEPHAESTUS FUND I of the AIF I.H. HEPHAESTUS INVESTMENT AIF V.C.I.C. PLC
item.description: CySEC has announced the dissolution and voluntary liquidation of the HEPHAESTUS FUND I investment compartment following the total redemption of its units.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of the investment compartment AUKA PROPERTY FUND of the AIFLNP AUKA AIFLNP V.C.I.C. LTD
item.description: CySEC announces the dissolution and voluntary liquidation of the AUKA PROPERTY FUND following the total redemption of its units.

item.title: Tender regarding ‘The Provision of Strategic Communications and Media Relations Services focusing on the European and International Media’
item.description: CySEC is seeking a strategic communications partner to manage its international media relations and reputation across European and global markets.

item.title: Road Freight Transport - Freight transport in Cyprus +2,3% and from and to Cyprus +17,7% (2nd Quarter 2026)
item.description: Cyprus road freight transport grew in Q2 2026, with a significant 17.7% surge in international cargo alongside a modest 2.3% rise in domestic movement.

item.title: CYPRUS INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ENTREPRISES ASSOCIATION EVENT
item.description: CITEA hosted a networking event to promote synergies among Cyprus IT companies and highlight international development opportunities through the Trade Service.

item.title: Kava Lend loses roughly $3.8 million to hack, sending KAVA token down nearly 40%
item.description: DeFi lending protocol Kava Lend suffered a $3.8 million exploit, causing the KAVA token to plummet by 40% amid wider market stability concerns.

item.title: Mastercard launches Wallet Pay to scale digital wallets worldwide
item.description: Mastercard's new Wallet Pay solution enables digital wallet providers to scale globally and achieve interoperability across millions of acceptance points.

item.title: Scams: What to watch out for ahead of Black Friday and Christmas shopping traffic
item.description: Cyprus banks warn of a seasonal surge in phishing and social engineering scams targeting consumers during the Black Friday and Christmas shopping period.

item.title: CySEC Warning regarding the website apex-capitalltd.com - 06/02/2025
item.description: CySEC has issued a policy statement regarding legislative amendments to the Financial Conglomerates Directive to align national oversight with updated EU standards.

item.title: Commission unconditionally approves UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank
item.description: The European Commission has unconditionally approved UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank, signaling a major push for cross-border banking consolidation within the European Economic Area.

item.title: Speech by President von der Leyen at the Enlargement Forum
item.description: President von der Leyen reaffirms the EU's commitment to enlargement, citing the economic and security benefits of the 2004 expansion as a blueprint for future growth.

item.title: Commission partially greenlights Romania's fifth payment request for €2.67 billion under NextGenerationEU
item.description: The EU Commission partially approved Romania's €2.67 billion payment request, withholding funds for six unfulfilled milestones related to energy and SME support.

item.title: Commission partially greenlights Slovakia's eighth payment request for €548 million under NextGenerationEU
item.description: The European Commission partially approved Slovakia's €548 million RRF payment request, withholding funds due to unmet environmental and energy targets.

item.title: Commission disburses another €1.71 billion to Ukraine for drones, ammunition and air defence systems
item.description: The European Commission disbursed €1.71 billion to Ukraine for defense procurement, with 40% earmarked for EU-based manufacturers under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan.

item.title: Opening remarks by Executive Vice-President Teresa Ribera on the Commission decision to approve UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank
item.description: The European Commission has approved UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank, marking the largest cross-border banking merger since the financial crisis to combat EU market fragmentation.

item.title: The European Innovation Council selects 35 deep tech companies for its Accelerator support
item.description: The European Innovation Council awards €84 million to 35 deep tech companies, offering grants and equity to scale breakthrough innovations across the EU.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – 13th annual memorial service of the former President of the...
item.description: President Nikos Christodoulides attended the 13th annual memorial service for former President Glafcos Clerides at the Apostolos Varnavas Cathedral in Nicosia.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Cyprus Universities Rectors’ Conference
item.description: President Christodoulides met with the Cyprus Universities Rectors’ Conference to discuss strategic developments in higher education and the sector's role in the national economy.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Cyprus Property Developers Association
item.description: President Nikos Christodoulides met with the Cyprus Property Developers Association to discuss strategic challenges and legislative reforms in the real estate sector.

item.title: Energy Minister – “She Means Business” event
item.description: Cyprus Minister of Energy Michael Damianos hosted the "She Means Business" event to celebrate and promote female entrepreneurship across the island's commercial and industrial sectors.

item.title: Real household income in the OECD contracts slightly in Q2 2026
item.description: OECD real household income per capita edged down 0.1% in Q2 2026, as persistent inflation began outpacing nominal wage gains despite continued GDP growth.

item.title: AMLA identifies AML/CFT priorities for the review of MiCA
item.description: AMLA outlines key AML/CFT priorities for the upcoming MiCA review, targeting DeFi, staking, and stablecoin oversight to close regulatory loopholes.

item.title: Press Release: AMLA consults on draft standards for an EU-wide AML/CFT database
item.description: AMLA launches public consultation on a new central EU AML/CFT database designed to consolidate supervisory data and streamline cross-border risk assessment.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1 billion for the second week in a row as crypto funds, except one, continue bleeding
item.description: Bitcoin ETFs recorded over $1 billion in weekly outflows for the second consecutive week, signaling a cooling of institutional crypto demand amid market volatility.

item.title: Official Journal 15/11/2026
item.description: The European Union has published new legislative updates in the Official Journal as of November 15, 2026, signaling potential regulatory changes for Cyprus-based firms.

item.title: ASEAN’s Brave New Frontier
item.description: ASEAN leads global growth through regional trade integration, digital frameworks, and AI adoption, signaling shifting trade patterns and new opportunities for international service providers.

item.title: Publication of the Annual Report of the Cyprus FIU for the year 2025
item.description: The Cyprus FIU (MOKAS) has released its 2025 Annual Report, detailing operational data, emerging financial crime trends, and risk assessment metrics for the past year.

item.title: AbleBook’s Andreas Vasiliou Takes On His First Marathon as Community Team Runs and Rolls for Inclusion
item.description: AbleBook, Stoiximan Wheels of Change and Yparxo opened their 5 km Corporate Race team to the public, while Vasiliou and teammate Marios Antonios Marshall lined up for their first full marathon in Larnaka.
